{{Quote|From Janguine?''"<br />"''Oh, I hardly think that likely. The jungle barbarians have not been around for more than three hundred years.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>}}
'''Janguine''' was a jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Its natives spoke [[Janguine (language)|Janguine]] and were overrun by the [[Mooloolian]]s around [[275 BBY]].
